name: Josephine Smith
source:
Josephine Smith seems to be all over Rackham City. She figures prominently in [url=/c176650]John[/url]'s photos of Donna cheating on her husband, she even seemed to enjoy his presence. She was also at the Berg Party when the necklace was stolen. John also found out that she is a switch hitter, she fancies both women and men. Josephine is adventurous, smart, and dangerous.

[Edited from in-game description]
